description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractConfigurationProvider' for AWS SDK configuration providers, providing methods to handle configuration caching, chaining providers, environment variable handling, and error rejection within the SDK's configuration management subsystem.

classes.name: AbstractConfigurationProvider
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for AWS SDK configuration providers, including caching, chaining, environment variable retrieval, and error handling.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a configuration provider with caching functionality, storing and retrieving configuration objects in a cache.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates a chain of configuration providers invoked sequentially until one returns a configuration.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Retrieves the user's home directory from environment variables, supporting Unix and Windows systems.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Determines the default AWS config file location based on environment variables and user home directory.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache its configuration result, returning a cached configuration on subsequent calls.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise with a standardized exception message.
